_doc: Build-specific obfuscated names used by formatters (they rotate on every game update). Roles are stable; values change.

avg_prices._doc: ObjectAveragePricesEvent: repeated entries of (item gid, average per-unit price over the last week). The third field of an entry is unused.

inventory._doc: InventoryContentEvent (sent at login) -> objects: ObjectItemInventory {item: ObjectItem {gid, uid, quantity, effects: ObjectEffect}, position (0-15 equipped, 63 bag)}; ObjectAdded/ObjectsAdded/ObjectModified events carry ObjectItemInventory, ObjectDeleted/ObjectsDeleted object uids.
